The invention aims to provide a vehicle seat capable of effectively using the vacant space created after the seat cushion is tipped up. In particular, when the seat cushion is rotated upward, the space that becomes available below or around the seat cushion can be used as a luggage storage space, thereby improving the utility and convenience of the vehicle interior.

The vehicle seat includes a seat cushion and a seat back. The seat cushion is configured to support an occupant in a seated position, while the seat back supports the occupant’s back. The vehicle seat further includes support legs that bear or support the load associated with the seat cushion. These support legs help maintain the seat cushion in a stable state during normal use and contribute to the overall strength and reliability of the seat structure.

In addition, the vehicle seat includes a leg holding member. The leg holding member is configured to hold a lower portion of the support leg. By holding the lower part of the support leg, the leg holding member can stabilize the support leg and ensure that the seat cushion is properly supported when the seat is in its normal seating position.

The vehicle seat also includes a slide mechanism. The slide mechanism allows the seat cushion and the seat back to move in the front-and-rear direction of the vehicle. This makes it possible to adjust the position of the seat according to the needs of the occupant or the vehicle interior arrangement. The slide mechanism may also contribute to securing or adjusting the available space when the seat cushion is tipped up.

Furthermore, the vehicle seat has a tip-up function. In this function, the seat cushion is rotated upward from its normal seating position so that the seating surface of the seat cushion faces the front surface of the seat back. When the seat cushion is in this tipped-up position, the area that was previously occupied by the seat cushion becomes vacant. This vacant area can then be used as a luggage storage space, enabling efficient use of the vehicle cabin space. Thus, the invention provides a vehicle seat that combines seating functionality, adjustability, and improved storage capability.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a vehicle seat structure configured to make effective use of the space that becomes available when a seat cushion is tipped upward.

In a vehicle seat having a tip-up function, the seat cushion can be rotated or lifted from its normal seating position to an upright or raised position. When the cushion is tipped up, a vacant space is created in the area that was previously occupied by the cushion or beneath the cushion. However, in conventional structures, this space may not be fully usable because support legs, holding components, or slide mechanism parts remain in positions that interfere with luggage or other stored articles.

The present invention provides a seat structure designed to reduce such interference and to improve the usability of the vacant space. The seat includes a seat cushion, support legs for supporting the seat cushion, a leg holding member that holds or receives the support legs, a slide mechanism that allows the seat to move forward and rearward, and a tip-up mechanism that enables the seat cushion to be tipped upward.

The slide mechanism includes a fixed portion attached to the vehicle body and a moving portion that moves relative to the fixed portion. The leg holding member is arranged on the moving portion of the slide mechanism. Because the leg holding member moves together with the seat when the seat is slid, it does not remain in a fixed position on the vehicle floor where it would obstruct the storage area. As a result, when the seat cushion is tipped up, the space beneath or around the raised cushion is opened more effectively.

With this arrangement, the vacant space created by tipping up the seat cushion can be used as a luggage storage space. Bags, boxes, or other articles can be placed in this area with fewer obstructions from the seat support structure. The invention therefore improves convenience for vehicle occupants by increasing the practical storage capacity inside the vehicle while maintaining the sliding and tip-up functions of the seat.

In addition, since the leg holding member is provided on the moving part of the slide mechanism, the support legs can be held in an appropriate position regardless of the sliding position of the seat. This contributes to stable support of the seat cushion during normal use and also allows the seat cushion to be tipped up smoothly when additional storage space is required.

Accordingly, the invention provides a vehicle seat structure that combines a slide function, a support-leg arrangement, and a tip-up function in a manner that enables the space beneath the tipped-up seat cushion to be effectively used for storing luggage or other items.

**The Power of “The”**

“The” may be one of the smallest words in the English language, but it plays a powerful role in communication. As a definite article, “the” helps us point to something specific. When we say “a book,” we may mean any book, but when we say “the book,” we are referring to a particular one that the listener or reader can identify.

This simple word brings clarity and precision to language. It helps connect ideas, guide attention, and create meaning. For example, “the sun,” “the ocean,” and “the future” all feel specific and familiar because of the word “the.” Without it, sentences can sound incomplete or unclear.

Although “the” is often overlooked, it is essential in everyday speech and writing. It reminds us that even the smallest words can have a major impact on how we understand the world.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a vehicle seat invention with a tip-up seat cushion, support legs, a leg holding member, and a slide mechanism, emphasizing use of the vacant space as luggage storage.
counterfactuals.output: A vehicle seat includes a seat cushion configured to be tipped up from a seating position to a raised storage position, a seat back, and a slide mechanism configured to move the vehicle seat in a vehicle front-rear direction. A plurality of support legs are provided beneath the seat cushion and are movable between a deployed state, in which the support legs support the seat cushion in the seating position, and a retracted state corresponding to the raised storage position of the seat cushion. A leg holding member is arranged to hold the support legs in the retracted state when the seat cushion is tipped up. When the seat cushion is raised and the support legs are held by the leg holding member, a vacant space is formed below and/or in front of the raised seat cushion. The slide mechanism permits positional adjustment of the vehicle seat so that the vacant space can be enlarged or conveniently located, thereby enabling the vacant space to be effectively used as a luggage storage area within a vehicle compartment.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft an “object of the invention” and brief configuration description for a vehicle seat that creates usable luggage space after the seat cushion is tipped up.
counterfactuals.output:
### Object of the Invention

An object of the invention is to provide a vehicle seat capable of creating a practical luggage storage space in a passenger compartment by tipping up a seat cushion, while maintaining good usability and a simple seat structure.

Another object of the invention is to provide a vehicle seat in which, when the seat cushion is moved to an upright or tipped-up position, an area normally occupied by the seat cushion can be used as a luggage placement area, thereby improving cargo-carrying flexibility without requiring removal of the seat from the vehicle.

A further object of the invention is to provide a vehicle seat that allows the seat cushion to be easily moved between a seating position and a luggage-space forming position, and that can stably hold the seat cushion in the tipped-up position so that luggage can be placed in the space exposed below or behind the seat cushion.

### Brief Configuration Description

The vehicle seat includes a seat cushion configured to support an occupant’s thighs and hips, a seat back connected to or arranged behind the seat cushion, and a cushion support mechanism that supports the seat cushion so that the seat cushion can be rotated or tipped upward from a normal seating position to a tipped-up position.

In the normal seating position, the seat cushion extends generally horizontally and cooperates with the seat back to form a seating area for an occupant. In the tipped-up position, the seat cushion is raised, for example toward the seat back or toward a substantially vertical orientation, thereby exposing a space that was occupied by the seat cushion or located beneath the seat cushion. This exposed space serves as a luggage storage space.

The cushion support mechanism may include a hinge or pivot portion provided at a front, rear, or side portion of the seat cushion, and a holding mechanism for retaining the seat cushion in the tipped-up position. The holding mechanism may include a latch, lock, stopper, spring, damper, link mechanism, or any combination thereof.

The seat may further include a floor-side support, frame, or base member defining or bordering the luggage space when the seat cushion is tipped up. The exposed luggage space may be substantially flat or may include a tray, recess, cover, or protective surface for receiving luggage. As a result, the vehicle seat can be selectively used either as an occupant seat or as a luggage-space forming structure, thereby improving the utility of the vehicle interior.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3
